baseline_exempt_reason: The sizing decision string already exists; proof of this change is a breakout sizing record dated after the deploy whose total-limb equals 1.9 x equity minus all notional (the evaluator compares the dated record), plus, when the floor is used, the new text 'stop risk $N <= $M' that only this code emits.
expected_rate: Every breakout entry scan with a signal (once per trading day from 10:05 ET); a second lot is admitted when the K limb room >= one slot
window_reason: Breakout signals are not daily; five sessions allow for days with no signal
reversal: Total overnight notional exceeds 1.9 x equity after a breakout entry, a lot risks more than 3% of equity at its stop, or a promotion/entry is sized against the old 1.75 limb
